# CLI reference

Every command's `--help`. The global `--config` option applies to all of them.

## nightshift

```text
Usage: nightshift [options] [command]

Spend idle coding-subscription quota overnight

Options:
  -V, --version          output the version number
  -c, --config <path>    config file (default: $NIGHT_SHIFT_CONFIG or
                         ~/.config/night-shift/config.yml)
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]         detect installed agents, pick providers, sources and a
                         starting queue
  config                 inspect and validate the config
  plan [options]         show tonight's units in order, with each provider's
                         ceiling; runs no worker
  queue                  show what each rule matches tonight and reorder the
                         rules with the keyboard
  skip [options] [key]   leave an item (source:key, e.g. github:acme/api#5)
                         alone on the coming nights; with no key, list skipped
                         items
  unskip <key>           let night-shift pick up a skipped item (source:key)
                         again
  skills                 list skills and eject built-ins to tweak
  run [options]          plan tonight, run a worker per unit and publish draft
                         PRs and reports
  report [options] [id]  print a run's morning report; the latest by default
  replay <run> <unit>    re-run a past run's unit on its base commit and saved
                         context with today's skills and instructions; nothing
                         is pushed
  schedule               run night-shift every night on this machine or in
                         GitHub Actions
  doctor [options]       check binaries, credentials, quota and sources before a
                         night
  help [command]         display help for command
```

## nightshift init

```text
Usage: nightshift init [options]

detect installed agents, pick providers, sources and a starting queue

Options:
  -y, --yes            answer every question with its default; needs no terminal
  --provider <id...>   with --yes: providers, first takes units first
  --source <id...>     with --yes: sources to take work from
  --night <start-end>  with --yes: night window, e.g. 01:00-07:00
  --force              replace an existing config without asking
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## nightshift config

```text
Usage: nightshift config [options] [command]

inspect and validate the config

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  schema          print the config JSON Schema, for editor autocompletion
  check           validate the config file
  edit            open the config in $VISUAL or $EDITOR; it is saved only once
                  valid
  help [command]  display help for command
```

## nightshift plan

```text
Usage: nightshift plan [options]

show tonight's units in order, with each provider's ceiling; runs no worker

Options:
  --json      print the plan and warnings as JSON
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift queue

```text
Usage: nightshift queue [options] [command]

show what each rule matches tonight and reorder the rules with the keyboard

Options:
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  move <from> <to>  move the rule at position <from> to position <to>, as
                    numbered by queue
```

## nightshift queue move

```text
Usage: nightshift queue move [options] <from> <to>

move the rule at position <from> to position <to>, as numbered by queue

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift skip

```text
Usage: nightshift skip [options] [key]

leave an item (source:key, e.g. github:acme/api#5) alone on the coming nights;
with no key, list skipped items

Options:
  --until <date>   skip until this local date (YYYY-MM-DD) starts; default:
                   until unskip
  --reason <text>  why, shown by nightshift plan
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

## nightshift unskip

```text
Usage: nightshift unskip [options] <key>

let night-shift pick up a skipped item (source:key) again

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift skills

```text
Usage: nightshift skills [options] [command]

list skills and eject built-ins to tweak

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  list            skills a rule can name, where each comes from and its delivery
                  default
  eject <name>    copy a built-in skill to skills/ beside the config, where it
                  shadows the built-in
  help [command]  display help for command
```

## nightshift skills list

```text
Usage: nightshift skills list [options]

skills a rule can name, where each comes from and its delivery default

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift skills eject

```text
Usage: nightshift skills eject [options] <name>

copy a built-in skill to skills/ beside the config, where it shadows the
built-in

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift run

```text
Usage: nightshift run [options]

plan tonight, run a worker per unit and publish draft PRs and reports

Options:
  --dry-run    prepare each workspace (clone, context, prompt) but run no worker
  --unit <id>  run only this unit, by id or item key
  --scheduled  run only inside the night window and start no unit after it ends
  -h, --help   display help for command
```

## nightshift report

```text
Usage: nightshift report [options] [id]

print a run's morning report; the latest by default

Options:
  --list      list the last 20 runs: units, draft PRs and reports
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift replay

```text
Usage: nightshift replay [options] <run> <unit>

re-run a past run's unit on its base commit and saved context with today's
skills and instructions; nothing is pushed

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule [options] [command]

run night-shift every night on this machine or in GitHub Actions

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  install [options]  start `nightshift run` when a window opens; it starts no
                     unit after it closes
  remove             remove the nightly job, and
                     .github/workflows/night-shift.yml in the current repo
  status             show the installed nightly job
  help [command]     display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule install

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule install [options]

start `nightshift run` when a window opens; it starts no unit after it closes

Options:
  --with <scheduler>  launchd, systemd, cron, github-actions (default: launchd
                      on macOS, else systemd if it runs, else cron)
  -h, --help          display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule remove

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule remove [options]

remove the nightly job, and .github/workflows/night-shift.yml in the current
repo

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift schedule status

```text
Usage: nightshift schedule status [options]

show the installed nightly job

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## nightshift doctor

```text
Usage: nightshift doctor [options]

check binaries, credentials, quota and sources before a night

Options:
  --json      print the checks as a JSON array of { status, what, detail }
  -h, --help  display help for command
```
